name: Conjure Siege Weapon, Greater
body:
School conjuration (creation); Level sorcerer/wizard 8, vanguard 6
Duration 1 hour/level (D)

DESCRIPTION

This functions as conjure siege weapon, except you can summon a siege weapon of up to Gargantuan size with a base value of 2,000 gp or less. You also conjure one piece of ammunition per caster level instead of the normal amount for conjure siege weapon.
